parameters.query:
INSERT INTO workflow_runs (
  organization_id,
  workflow_key,
  n8n_execution_id,
  status,
  correlation_id,
  input,
  error,
  started_at,
  finished_at
)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM organizations LIMIT 1),
  'WF-24',
  NULLIF('{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.execution_id }}', ''),
  'failed',
  '{{ $('Normalize Error').item.json.correlation_id }}'::uuid,
  '{}'::jsonb,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'source_workflow', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.workflow_name }}',
    'source_workflow_id', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.workflow_id }}',
    'failed_node', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.failed_node }}',
    'error_name', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.error_name }}',
    'error_message', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.error_message }}',
    'severity', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.severity }}',
    'retryable', {{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.retryable }},
    'action', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.retryable ? "RETRY_FAILED_ALERT" : "ALERT_ONLY" }}',
    'occurred_at', '{{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.occurred_at }}'
  ),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id, status, correlation_id;

parameters.subject: =🚨 [WF-24] SYSTEM ERROR - {{ $('Analyze Error').item.json.workflow_name }}
parameters.message:
={{ `

🚨 WF-24 - SYSTEM ERROR ALERT

Workflow: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.workflow_name}

Failed Node: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.failed_node}

Severity: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.severity}

Error: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.error_message}

Execution ID: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.execution_id || 'N/A'}

Correlation ID: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.correlation_id}

Retryable: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.retryable ? 'YES' : 'NO'}

Action: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.retryable ? 'RETRY_FAILED_ALERT' : 'ALERT_ONLY'}

Occurred At: ${$('Analyze Error').item.json.occurred_at}

WF-24 System Logging & Alerts

The source workflow has failed. If this was a retryable API/network error, the configured retry attempts were exhausted. Please check the failed workflow and execution immediately.

` }}
